versions.changelog:
Introduces a LinkedIn audience persona builder grounded in live Taplio data.

- Uses Taplio audience settings and real LinkedIn posts to validate persona details, pains, and vocabulary.
- Guides users through 12 audience questions in batches, then creates a persona card and 10 post topic ideas.
- Requires the Taplio MCP; without it, the skill stops and provides setup instructions.
- Builds one specific persona at a time and does not draft, schedule, or publish posts.
